history.author: Appsara
history.description: Initial version created based on the confirmed screen designs

purpose: This document explains the purpose of EMS's Depot Activity details.
features: This option is used to update Empty Pickup/Full Return Depot details against booking.
This option allows user can assign Empty Pickup/Full Return Depot/Turn in Reference.
The Query Fields of Depot Activity allows the user to query depot activity data as per requirement.
Data Grid Screen allows the user to view data queried using query fields.
This screen allows the user to overwrite existing data like Empty Pickup, Full Return, etc.
This screen allows the user to access Booking wise menu and group function menu.

events.description: Queries the port releases matching the entered query fields and lists them in the data grid.
events.triggered_when: User enters data in one or more query fields and clicks Search.

events.description: Clears multiple query fields at once to query with new data.
Shows or hides the query fields panel.
events.triggered_when: User clicks the arrow at the right of the grid search box.

events.description: Sorts the port releases in the data grid by the selected option.
events.triggered_when: User selects an option in the Sort By drop down after querying data.

events.description: Filters the port releases listed in the data grid by the entered text.
events.triggered_when: User enters text in the grid search box after querying data.

events.description: Exports the port releases listed in the data grid to an Excel file.
events.triggered_when: User clicks the Excel icon after querying data.

events.description: Reloads the data grid with the latest data for the current query.
Selects or deselects all port releases (header check box) or a single record (row check box).
events.triggered_when: User clicks the header select all check box or the check box of a record.

events.description: Opens the EMS Movement Query & Update screen (EMS Normal Query) - Query Screen for the record.
events.triggered_when: User clicks the eye icon of a record.

events.description: Opens the group function menu of the screen for the selected records.
events.triggered_when: User selects one or more records and clicks the ☰ icon near the screen name.

events.description: Opens the single function menu of the record.
events.triggered_when: User clicks the ☰ icon near the PR Number of a record.

events.description: Overwrites the old data of the selected records with the new data entered in the edit fields.
events.triggered_when: User selects records, enters data in the edit fields and clicks the Overwrite check box.

events.description: Clears the data entered in the edit fields.
Applies the data entered in the edit fields to the selected records so that the user can preview the new data before actually submitting it.
events.triggered_when: User selects one or more records, enters data in the edit fields and clicks Apply.

events.description: Cancels the change from old data to new data.
events.triggered_when: User clicks Cancel after clicking Apply.

events.description: Submits the new data of the selected records.
events.triggered_when: User clicks Submit after applying the changes.
